description: Equipment service relevant to MND needs such as mobility, bathroom, transfer, pressure care and communication equipment.
eligibility: Check FlexEquip and state MND association criteria.
funding_notes: May intersect with MND association support, NDIS, aged care or state equipment pathways.
name: MND assistive equipment

description: Assistive technology access for eligible adults with MND in NSW or ACT and eligible NDIS participants.
eligibility: Adults in NSW or ACT diagnosed with MND who need assistive technology, or eligible NDIS participants over 18 with AT funding.
funding_notes: Longer-term funding through funding bodies such as EnableNSW should be used where possible.
name: FlexEquip assistive technology access

description: Equipment request process for allied health professionals seeking MND Victoria equipment.
eligibility: Request must be submitted by an appropriate allied health professional.
funding_notes: MND Victoria is an NDIS registered assistive technology provider.
name: MND Victoria equipment requests

description: MND-specific guidance on wheelchairs, hoists, walking aids, ramps, electric beds, armchairs, pressure care mattresses, over-toilet aids, communication technology and home modifications.
eligibility: People living with MND and their carers should seek assessment from allied health professionals and local MND associations.
funding_notes: May involve local MND associations, NDIS, My Aged Care, home care packages, palliative care services, or state schemes.
name: Assistive technology and home modifications for MND

description: Information about non-invasive ventilation, BiPAP/VPAP machines, masks, cough assistance, suction and respiratory planning for MND.
eligibility: Respiratory equipment should be assessed and prescribed through the respiratory physician and MND care team.
funding_notes: Funding and supply may involve health services, NDIS, MND associations, aged care or palliative services depending on age and circumstances.
name: Respiratory equipment and NIV guidance
